audit.why: Poppy at 1 and at 6, Akali from 3 and from first item, matches 47.89% Emerald+ over 957 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early and whys[0] both say Akali has 'no Shroud until level 2', and breakdown.spikes gives her 'levels 2-3'. breakdown.spikes also leaves Poppy's level 6 unnamed.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is her W and cannot be learned before level 3, so the whole 'wait for your kit' window is one level later than the page says - and level 2 is the stage where the reader will now walk up expecting a tool she does not have. Poppy's level-6 spike is Keeper's Verdict on 140/120/100s.
audit.corrected: content early and whys[0] now say level 3; breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why rebuilt on level 3 and the 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence carries no cooldown anywhere; Keeper's Verdict's untargetability is never mentioned; and content wants.you[1] says Five Point Strike gives 'the slow and the energy/heal'.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s - 20 seconds at rank 1 is long enough that baiting it is a genuine plan rather than a hope, and Riot's text adds that a dash it stops leaves you slowed AND grounded, so a failed flip costs more than the dash. Keeper's Verdict makes Poppy untargetable while she channels it (the _missing file flags this matchup untargetable-dodges-burst on exactly that), so a combo committed into the channel is spent for nothing. And Five Point Strike returns no energy and no health - Akali's kit has no heal at all, so that clause was inventing sustain.

edits.before: Poppy out-stats you at every early level: her passive Iron Ambassador and shielded autos make her trades cost-efficient, her Q (Hammer Shock) leaves a zone that punishes you for standing to last-hit, and you only have Q with no Shroud until level 2. The real trap is her W (Steadfast Presence): if you burn E to flip onto her, she just stands in the aura and your dash is grounded, then she E-charges (Heroic Charge) you into the wall for a stun.
